_comment: CONCEPT:MEDULLA-KG.query.perf-recall-ci-gate — committed perf/recall regression thresholds for the medulla-plan hybrid_queries bench, consumed by scripts/bench_gate.py. The recall floor is the TIGHT, deterministic gate (fixed dataset + fixed HNSW params). The per-bench p50 ceilings (nanoseconds) are DELIBERATELY generous (~10-100x a warm local run) so ordinary CI-machine variance never trips them — they only catch a CATASTROPHIC algorithmic regression (e.g. an accidental O(n^2) blowup in a leg). A bench absent under the run's feature set is skipped, not failed.

finance_r613._comment: MEDULLA-FINANCE-PRIMITIVES-R613.6: p99 budgets in ms for the r613_finance_primitives report (target/finance-r613-report.json). baseline_p99_ms is the stored run a later run may exceed by at most regression_tolerance; null until the pinned bench lane records one.
